This appears to be a CBP ruling on the huupe ARENA. The device is described as a video game console that connects to an external display and has preloaded games. The likely classification is heading 9504, video game consoles and machines, in subheading 9504.50, which covers video game consoles and machines other than those of 9504.30.

Within 9504.50, the statistical suffixes are:
- 9504.50.0000 for video game consoles and machines, articles and accessories thereof. 
- 9504.50.0000 was split in later schedules, so in current HTSUS it is 9504.50.00 with 9504.50.0000 as the 10-digit code.

Heading 9504.90 covers other articles, but the ruling treated this as a video game console that uses an external display. I am working from memory of the ruling rather than a verified citation, so I am going with 9504.50.0000.
